problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $Y$ has the probability mass function $f(y)$ and the cumulative distribution function $F(y)$ as shown in the table below, compute $a+b+c.$

| $y$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(y)$ | $0.1$ | $0.2$ | $0.2$ | $0.4$ | $0.1$ |
| $F(y)$ | $0.1$ | $a$ | $0.5$ | $b$ | $c$ |

activity_context.topic_title: Cumulative Distribution Functions for Discrete Random Variables

examples.knowledge_point: Computing a CDF Given the PMF
examples.problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $Y$ has the probability mass function $f(y),$ shown in the table below, and the cumulative distribution function $F(y),$ compute $F(2).$

| $y$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(y)$ | $\dfrac{1}{2}$ | $\dfrac{1}{8}$ | $\dfrac{1}{4}$ | $\dfrac{1}{8}$ |
examples.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $Y$ is the function $F(y)$ defined by

$$
F(y) = P(Y \leq y).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(2) & =P(Y\le 2) \\  & =P(Y\in {1,2}) \\  & =P(Y=1)+P(Y=2) \\  & =f(1)+f(2) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{8} \\  & =\frac{5}{8}.\end{aligned}
$$
